title: Popular YouTuber Pranks Celtics Fans At TD Garden With Fake Marriage Proposal During Raptors Game [Watch]
htmlContent:
Cheeseaholic, a popular YouTuber known for his love for cheese and basketball, decided to propose to his girlfriend during the third quarter of the Raptors and Celtics game. As the camera panned to him during a timeout, he got down on one knee and pulled out a ring, causing the entire arena to erupt in cheers and applause. However, as he nervously asked his girlfriend to marry him, she hesitated before eventually shaking her head and saying no, leaving Cheeseaholic devastated.

The moment was captured on camera and quickly went viral, with many people sympathizing with Cheeseaholic and expressing their support for him. However, some also criticized him for proposing in such a public and potentially humiliating way, with others questioning the authenticity of the proposal and whether it was staged for views. Regardless of the motive behind the proposal, it was undoubtedly a heartbreaking moment for Cheeseaholic, who will now have to navigate the aftermath of such a public rejection.

Turns out Cheeseholic, plan the whole time was to prank the Celtics crowd with this prank and for his camera man catch it on film to share on Youtube.

For Cheeseholic rejection was planned, some might say this next one that happened earlier this the season might not have been. It happened with 9:29 minutes to go into the second quarter at a February game between the Dallas Mavericks and Los Angeles Lakers, during a timeout, the ventilator tried to propose to his girlfriend, but instead of receiving a "yes" and then a kiss, his girlfriend decided to run up the stairs and decline the proposal.
